class SegmentTree:
    def __init__(self, arr):
        size = len(arr)
        n = 1 << (size - 1).bit_length()
        self.n = n
        node = [0] * (2 * n)
        node[n - 1:n - 1 + size] = arr
        for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
            left = node[2 * i + 1]
            right = node[2 * i + 2]
            node[i] = left if left > right else right
        self.node = node

    def update(self, x, val):
        x += self.n - 1
        node = self.node
        node[x] = val
        while x > 0:
            x = (x - 1) >> 1
            left = node[2 * x + 1]
            right = node[2 * x + 2]
            node[x] = left if left > right else right

    def query(self, a, b):
        res = 0
        l = self.n - 1 + a
        r = self.n - 1 + (b - 1)
        node = self.node

        while l <= r:
            if l == r:
                v = node[l]
                return res if res > v else v
            if (l & 1) == 0:
                v = node[l]
                res = res if res > v else v
            if (r & 1) == 1:
                v = node[r]
                res = res if res > v else v
            l >>= 1
            r = (r >> 1) - 1

class BinaryIndexedTree:

        n = len(A)

        self.node = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.data = [0] * (n + 1)

        s = 0
        node = self.node
        data = self.data
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            ai = A[i - 1]
            s += ai
            data[i] = ai
            node[i] = s - (s - ai if (i & -i) == 1 else 0)

    def add(self, i, v):
        node = self.node
        data = self.data
        n = self.n
        data[i] += v
        while i <= n:
            node[i] += v
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):
        rst = 0
        node = self.node
        while i > 0:
            rst += node[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return rst

    def get(self, i, j):
        if i == j:
            return self.data[i]
        return self.sum(j) - self.sum(i - 1)
